messages:
jamie: Hey 👋 first day here! Quick security/setup questions — where do I find the mandatory security training, and do I need to enroll my personal laptop in MDM or should I wait for a company laptop?
rachel (People Ops): Welcome Jamie!! :tada: You should get a welcome email with links. Mandatory training is in LMS (Security Foundations). Link in the email + you can find it here: https://redwood-internal.kb/training/security-foundations (log in with SSO). Please finish it within first week.
jamie: Thanks! I got the email but the LMS link asked for a code I don't have. Is that normal?
rachel (People Ops): Hmm — the code is the onboarding cohort code, it was in the onboarding checklist. I can DM it to you. If not, @punit can resend the invite.
punit (IT): Sent the LMS invite again to jamie@redwood.com. Also short note on devices: if you requested a company laptop it should be shipped; if you're on personal laptop temporarily, do NOT enroll personal devices in Jamf/Intune unless IT asks. Instead use the VPN + short-lived access token. We'll provision MDM once device is company-owned.
jamie: I requested a Mac and it's marked "in transit" on the order tracker. For now I'm on my personal Mac — how do I handle password manager and extensions?
theo (InfoSec): Good Q. Use 1Password (company account) via browser extension for work-related credentials. Avoid saving work creds in personal Safari/Chrome profiles. If you want to use the 1Password desktop app on personal device, ok temporarily but treat it like a shared machine: enable 2FA and lock when not in use.
jamie: Got it. Also I received an email about a "phishing simulation" scheduled — is that mandatory?
security-bot: Reminder: Phishing simulation cohort B runs next Tuesday. Participation is required as part of Security Foundations. If you fail the simulated phish, you'll be asked to take a 10-min refresher.
theo (InfoSec): Yes, it's mandatory, but it's educational — no penalties. If you think you got a simulated phish and you reported it, awesome :+1:. If you clicked and entered creds, follow the incident playbook: rotate that password and ping us.
jamie: If I do end up needing IT help during setup hours, what's the fastest channel?
punit (IT): #eng-infra is monitored during office hours, but for faster help DM me or open a ticket at https://redwood-internal.kb/it/tickets (or email it-help@redwood.com). For device enrollment we might ask for a Zoom session.
sam (manager): Hey Jamie — welcome to the team. Ping me if anything blocks you getting access to the repos or dev environment. We can pair on setup tomorrow.
jamie: Awesome, thanks everyone. One last thing — does Redwood require corporate VPN when on public wifi before MDM?
theo (InfoSec): Yes: always use the company VPN on public/untrusted networks. We enforce some routing for dev tooling. Use the built-in OpenVPN client config from the KB: https://redwood-internal.kb/security/vpn-setup
rachel (People Ops): I'll DM you the LMS cohort code now and check that your laptop shipment ETA is correct. Welcome again! :wave:
jamie: Thanks rachel — got the code and training loaded. Marking this thread closed unless anything else pops up. :smile:
